review_policy.raw_reference: all mutation and clue offsets must validate against the SHA-256 of the full raw line
review_policy.candidate_visibility: raw PN only; DS and unmodified mutation substring are not shown
review_policy.positive_requirements: one recorded mutation, at least two raw clinical clues, one medical principle, and an authoritative source basis
review_policy.clean_requirements: no clear candidate-visible anomaly in the allowed medical categories
review_policy.difficulty_note: consistency-assisted items are retained as easy controls and must not be described as knowledge-exclusive

accepted_items.review_note: 膿尿・CVA叩打痛・E. coli培養と抗ウイルス薬の不一致を統合する

胸腔ドレーン・エアリークと肺血栓塞栓症の不一致だが、後続PNに正しい診断が反復される
脾損傷・小腸損傷の無改変対照
肺血栓塞栓症・深部静脈血栓症の無改変対照
